en.s: On 22 January 613, the eight-month-old Heraclius Constantine, son of Emperor Heraclius and Eudokia, was crowned Byzantine co-emperor with the title Augustus at Constantinople, in present-day Turkey.

zh.t: 希拉克略·君士坦丁加冕为共治皇帝
zh.s: 613年1月22日，希拉克略皇帝与欧多西娅之子、年仅八个月的希拉克略·君士坦丁在君士坦丁堡（今土耳其境内）加冕为拜占庭共治皇帝，获得“奥古斯都”称号。

en.s: The Battle of Basing was a battle on 22 January 871 at Old Basing in what is now the English county of Hampshire. It was one of a series of battles that took place following an invasion of the then kingdom of Wessex by an army of Danes. Both battle and campaign are described in the Anglo-Saxon Chronicle. The Danes had established a camp at Reading, and the previous battles of Englefield, Reading and Ashdown had proved indecisive, with victories to both sides. Two weeks after the Saxon victory at Ashdown, the armies met again at Basing.

zh.s: 871年1月22日，贝辛战役发生在今英格兰汉普郡的老贝辛，是丹麦军队入侵威塞克斯王国后的一系列战斗之一。《盎格鲁-撒克逊编年史》记载了这场战斗及整个战役。丹麦人此前在雷丁扎营，恩格尔菲尔德、雷丁及阿什当几场战役双方各有胜负，未能决定战局。撒克逊人在阿什当获胜两周后，两军又在贝辛相遇。

en.s: The Battle of Pokarwis was a medieval battle fought in several skirmishes between pagan Old Prussians and the crusading Teutonic Knights on January 22, 1261 during the Great Prussian Uprising that followed the failed first Prussian Uprising of 1242-1249. After Lithuanians and Samogitians soundly defeated the joint forces of the Teutonic Knights and the Livonian Order in the Battle of Durbe in 1260, the Prussians rose against their conquerors once again.

zh.s: 波卡尔维斯战役是普鲁士大起义期间的一场中世纪战役，于1261年1月22日爆发，交战双方是信奉异教的古普鲁士人和条顿骑士团，战斗由多次小规模冲突组成。1242年至1249年的第一次普鲁士起义失败后，普鲁士人再次起事。此前在1260年的杜尔贝战役中，立陶宛人和萨莫吉希亚人曾彻底击败条顿骑士团与利沃尼亚骑士团联军。

en.s: On 22 January 1506, Swiss guards led by Kaspar von Silenen entered Rome, in present-day Italy. Their arrival is regarded as the official founding date of the Pontifical Swiss Guard.

zh.s: 1506年1月22日，卡斯帕·冯·西莱嫩率领的瑞士卫兵进入罗马，地点位于今意大利境内。他们抵达的这一天被视为教宗瑞士卫队正式成立的日期。

en.s: The Moldavian–Polish War of 1502–1510 was a conflict between the Kingdom of Poland and Moldavia and the Ottoman Empire supporting it. The war ended with a Polish victory under the Treaty of Kamieniec Podolski on January 22, 1510, in which Bogdan III the One-Eyed relinquished his claim to Pokuttia and his marriage plans to Elizabeth Jagiellon, and returned the marriage contract.

zh.t: 摩尔达维亚—波兰战争（1502—1510年）
zh.s: 1502年至1510年的摩尔达维亚—波兰战争，是波兰王国与摩尔达维亚之间的冲突，奥斯曼帝国支持摩尔达维亚。1510年1月22日，双方签署《卡缅涅茨-波多利斯基条约》，战争以波兰获胜结束。摩尔达维亚统治者独眼的博格丹三世放弃对波库蒂亚的主权要求，也放弃迎娶伊丽莎白·雅盖隆的计划，并归还婚约。

en.s: The Battle of Ridaniya or Battle of Ridanieh (Arabic: معركة الريدانية; Turkish: Ridaniye Muharebesi) was fought on January 22, 1517, in Egypt. The Ottoman forces of Selim I defeated the Mamluk forces under Al-Ashraf Tuman bay II. The Turks marched into Cairo, and the severed head of Tuman bay II, Egypt’s last Mamluk Sultan, was hung over an entrance gate in the Al Ghourieh quarter of Cairo.

zh.s: 里达尼亚战役又称里达尼耶战役（阿拉伯语：معركة الريدانية；土耳其语：Ridaniye Muharebesi），于1517年1月22日在埃及爆发。塞利姆一世率领的奥斯曼军队击败了图曼贝伊二世率领的马穆鲁克军队。奥斯曼军队进入开罗后，埃及最后一位马穆鲁克苏丹图曼贝伊二世被斩首，首级挂在开罗古里耶区一座城门上。

en.s: The Ottoman–Mamluk War of 1516–1517 was the second major conflict between the Egypt-based Mamluk Sultanate and the Ottoman Empire, which led to the Fall of the Mamluk Sultanate and the incorporation of the Levant, Egypt, and the Hejaz as provinces of the Ottoman Empire.

zh.t: 奥斯曼—马穆鲁克战争（1516—1517年）
zh.s: 1516年至1517年的奥斯曼—马穆鲁克战争，是以埃及为基地的马穆鲁克苏丹国与奥斯曼帝国之间的第二场重大冲突。战争导致马穆鲁克苏丹国覆灭，黎凡特、埃及和汉志地区被并入奥斯曼帝国，成为其行省。

en.s: The Livonian War (1558–1583) concerned the control of Old Livonia (in the territory of present-day Estonia and Latvia). The Tsardom of Russia faced a varying coalition of the Dano-Norwegian Realm, the Kingdom of Sweden, and the Union (later Commonwealth) of the Grand Duchy of Lithuania and the Kingdom of Poland. From 1558 to 1578, Russia dominated the region with early military successes at Dorpat (Tartu) and Narva.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 利沃尼亚战争（1558—1583年）围绕旧利沃尼亚的控制权展开，战场位于今天爱沙尼亚和拉脱维亚境内。俄罗斯沙皇国的对手是丹麦—挪威王国、瑞典王国，以及立陶宛大公国与波兰王国组成的联盟（后来成为联邦）。1558年至1578年间，俄罗斯在该地区占据上风，最初在多尔帕特（今塔尔图）和纳尔瓦等地取得军事胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Romhány (Battle of Szátok or Battle of Érsekvadkert) is one of the last battles of the Rákóczi War of Independence, which was fought on 22 January 1710 between Romhány and Szátok or Érsekvadkert in Nógrád counties.

zh.s: 罗马尼战役又称萨托克战役或埃尔谢克瓦德凯尔特战役，是拉科齐独立战争接近尾声时的一场战斗，于1710年1月22日在诺格拉德州罗马尼、萨托克或埃尔谢克瓦德凯尔特之间的地区进行。

en.s: The Battle of Jammu was fought between the Sikhs under the command of Banda Singh Bahadur against the Mughal forces near the hills of Jammu on 22 January 1712. The Mughals were able to achieve a victory against the Sikhs. Raja Dhruv Dev of Jammu supported the Mughals.

zh.s: 1712年1月22日，班达·辛格·巴哈杜尔率领锡克军与莫卧儿军队在查谟附近的山地交战。莫卧儿军队获胜。查谟统治者拉贾·德鲁夫·德夫支持莫卧儿一方。

en.s: The Battle of Wandiwash was a battle in India between the French and the British in 1760. The battle was part of the Third Carnatic War fought between the French and British colonial empires, which itself was a part of the global Seven Years' War. It took place at Vandavasi (Wandiwash being the Anglicised pronunciation) in Tamil Nadu.

zh.s: 万迪瓦什战役是1760年在印度发生的一场战斗，交战双方是法国和英国。战役属于第三次卡纳提克战争，而后者又是全球七年战争的一部分。战场位于泰米尔纳德邦的万达瓦西（Wandiwash是其英语化读音）。

en.t: 1770 Speaker of the British House of Commons election
en.s: The 1770 election of the Speaker of the House of Commons occurred on 22 January 1770. The election followed the resignation of incumbent Speaker Sir John Cust due to ill health. Cust died two days after this election. Sir Fletcher Norton was proposed by Lord North and seconded by Richard Rigby. Thomas Townshend was proposed by Lord John Cavendish and seconded by Lord George Sackville.

zh.s: 英国下议院于1770年1月22日选举议长。时任议长约翰·卡斯特爵士因健康原因辞职，卡斯特在选举两天后去世。弗莱彻·诺顿爵士由诺斯勋爵提名、理查德·里格比附议；托马斯·汤森则由约翰·卡文迪许勋爵提名、乔治·萨克维尔勋爵附议。

en.s: The capture of Demerara and Essequibo was a French military expedition carried out in January 1782 as part of the American Revolutionary War. In 1781 Admiral Lord Rodney sent two sloops from his fleet at Sint Eustatius to take possession of the Dutch colonies of Essequibo and Demerara. In 1782 the French successfully took possession of these settlements, compelling British Governor Robert Kingston to surrender.

zh.t: 法国攻占德梅拉拉和埃塞奎博
zh.s: 法国于1782年1月派出远征军，攻占德梅拉拉和埃塞奎博，这是美国独立战争期间的一次行动。1781年，罗德尼勋爵海军上将从圣尤斯特歇斯岛舰队派出两艘单桅帆船，夺取荷兰殖民地埃塞奎博和德梅拉拉。次年，法国成功占领这两地，迫使英国总督罗伯特·金斯顿投降。

en.s: The action of 22 January 1783 was a single-ship action fought off the Chesapeake Bay during the American War of Independence. The British frigate Hussar, under the command of Thomas Macnamara Russell, captured the French frigate Sybille, under the command of Théobald René de Kergariou-Locmaria. The circumstances of the battle included controversial French violations of accepted rules of war regarding the flying of false flags and distress signals.

zh.s: 1783年1月22日海战是美国独立战争期间在切萨皮克湾附近发生的一场单舰交战。托马斯·麦克纳马拉·拉塞尔指挥的英国护卫舰“胡萨尔号”俘获了蒂奥巴尔·勒内·德·克尔加里奥-洛克马里亚指挥的法国护卫舰“西比勒号”。交战中，法国军舰被指使用假旗和虚假的求救信号，违反公认的战争规则，因此引发争议。

en.s: The Action of 22 January 1809 was a minor naval engagement fought off the Caribbean island of Guadeloupe during the Napoleonic Wars. The action was fought as part of the blockade of Guadeloupe and neighbouring Martinique by a large British Royal Navy squadron, which was seeking to cut the islands off from contact and supplies from France by preventing the passage of shipping from Europe to the islands. The British blockade was part of their preparation for planned invasions during the next year.

zh.s: 1809年1月22日，拿破仑战争期间，加勒比海瓜德罗普岛外海发生一场小规模海战。英国皇家海军一支大型舰队，当时正封锁瓜德罗普及邻近马提尼克，阻止欧洲船只前往，切断两岛与法国的联系及补给。这次封锁也是英国为随后一年计划中的入侵所作的准备。

en.s: The siege of Olivença or Olivenza occurred on 19-22 January 1811 when French General Jean-de-Dieu Soult successfully undertook the capture of the run-down Spanish fortress of Olivenza in western Spain during the Peninsular War. On his way to storming the stronger fortress at Badajoz, Soult was obliged to modify his original plans.

zh.s: 奥利文萨围城战又称奥利文萨战役，于1811年1月19日至22日发生在半岛战争期间。法国将军让-德-迪厄·苏尔特成功攻占了西班牙西部已破败的奥利文萨要塞。此后，苏尔特原计划进攻防守更严密的巴达霍斯要塞，但被迫调整计划。

en.s: The Battle of Tenancingo was a military action of the Mexican War of Independence fought on 22 January 1812 on the outskirts of Tenancingo de Degollado, Mexico. The battle was fought between the royalist forces loyal to the Spanish crown and the Mexican rebels fighting for independence from the Spanish Empire. The Mexican insurgents were commanded by General José María Morelos y Pavón and the Spanish by Rosendo Porlier y Asteguieta. The battle resulted in a victory for the Mexican rebels.

zh.s: 1812年1月22日，墨西哥独立战争中的特南辛戈战役，在特南辛戈德德戈利亚多郊外展开。效忠西班牙王室的保王军，由罗森多·波列尔-阿斯特吉埃塔指挥；争取脱离西班牙帝国的墨西哥起义军，则由何塞·马里亚·莫雷洛斯-帕冯将军指挥。最终起义军获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Tacuarembó took place between the Luso-Brazilian forces under the command of José de Castelo Branco Correia, Count of Figueira, and the Artiguist forces of Andrés Latorre in Tacuarembó, modern-day Uruguay. The encounter resulted in a catastrophe for the Artiguist army. Indeed, out of 2,500 men, 500 were killed and 505 were captured, while the Luso-Brazilian forces only had 6 casualties (1 soldier killed and 5 wounded).

zh.s: 塔夸伦博战役的交战双方是若泽·德·卡斯特洛·布朗科·科雷亚伯爵率领的葡巴联军，以及安德烈斯·拉托雷率领的阿蒂加斯派军队，战斗发生在今天乌拉圭境内的塔夸伦博。阿蒂加斯派军队遭到惨败：2500人中有500人阵亡、505人被俘；葡巴联军仅有6人伤亡，其中1人阵亡、5人受伤。

en.s: Gubernatorial elections were held in El Salvador (then a part of the Federal Republic of Central America) on 22 January 1829. Conservative José María Cornejo defeated incumbent liberal governor Mariano Prado. Cornejo assumed office on 30 January 1829.

zh.s: 1829年1月22日，当时属于中美洲联邦共和国的萨尔瓦多举行州长选举。保守派何塞·马里亚·科尔内霍，击败自由派现任州长马里亚诺·普拉多，于1月30日就职。

en.s: The First Battle of Szolnok was a battle in the Hungarian war of Independence of 1848-1849, fought on 22 January 1849 between the revolutionary Hungarian army led by General Mór Perczel against the cavalry brigade of the Austrian Empire led by General Ferenc Ottinger. The isolated troops of Ottinger were attacked by Perczel's superior army and were forced to retreat from Szolnok to Abony, then to Cegléd.

zh.s: 索尔诺克第一次战役是1848—1849年匈牙利独立战争中的一场战斗，于1849年1月22日爆发。莫尔·佩尔采尔将军率领匈牙利革命军，对阵费伦茨·厄廷格将军率领的奥地利帝国骑兵旅。佩尔采尔的优势兵力袭击了孤立的厄廷格部队，迫使他们撤出索尔诺克，先后退往阿博尼和采格莱德。

en.s: The siege of Multan began on 19 April 1848 and lasted until 22 January 1849, and saw fighting around Multan (in present-day Punjab, Pakistan) between the British East India Company and the Sikh Empire. It began with a rebellion against a ruler imposed by the East India Company, which precipitated the Second Anglo-Sikh War, and ended when the last defenders of the city surrendered to British forces.

zh.s: 木尔坦围城战从1848年4月19日持续至1849年1月22日，英国东印度公司与锡克帝国在木尔坦周边交战，地点位于今巴基斯坦旁遮普省。当地反抗东印度公司强行扶立的统治者，围城由此开始，并引发第二次英锡战争。最终城内最后的守军向英军投降，围城结束。

en.s: The January Uprising (Polish: powstanie styczniowe, Lithuanian: 1863 m. sukilimas, Belarusian: Паўстанне 1863-1864 гадоў) was an uprising in the former Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth (present-day Poland, Lithuania, Belarus, Latvia, parts of Ukraine, and western Russia) against the Russian Empire. It began on 22 January 1863 and lasted until the last insurgents were captured in 1864. The uprising began as a spontaneous protest by young Poles against conscription into the Imperial Russian Army. It was soon joined by high-ranking Polish-Lithuanian officers and various politicians. The insurrectionists, severely outnumbered and lacking serious outside support, were forced to resort to guerrilla warfare tactics.

zh.s: 1863年1月22日，原波兰—立陶宛联邦地区爆发反抗俄罗斯帝国的一月起义，持续到1864年最后一批起义者被捕。范围包括今波兰、立陶宛、白俄罗斯、拉脱维亚、乌克兰部分地区及俄罗斯西部。起初，波兰青年自发抗议被征入俄罗斯帝国军队，随后高级波兰—立陶宛军官及多名政治人物加入。起义者人数远逊于对手，又缺乏有力外援，只得采用游击战术。

en.s: Battle of Ciołków (the village is now called Ciółkowo; north-east of Płock) of January 22, 1863, was the first skirmish of the January Uprising. Fought between an unorganised Polish troop of ca. 100 men under Aleksander Rogaliński and a company of the Russian Murom Regiment under Col. Kozlaninov, the skirmish resulted in Polish victory. As the engagement started on the very first day of the uprising, the Russian force still obeyed the orders of marching through the occupied country with their rifles unloaded. When the Russians approached a local manor in which the Poles had their quarters, the Russian commander ordered a loose formation and tried to negotiate an agreement and take all Poles into captivity.

zh.s: 1863年1月22日，普沃茨克东北的乔乌库夫，今称乔乌科沃，爆发一月起义首场小规模交战。亚历山大·罗加林斯基率领约100名组织松散的波兰人，与科兹拉尼诺夫上校率领的俄军穆罗姆团一个连交战，最终波兰一方获胜。战斗发生在起义第一天，俄军仍依照规定，以步枪未装弹的状态行军穿过占领区。他们接近波兰人驻扎的一座庄园时，俄军指挥官下令散开队形，试图谈判，让所有波兰人接受俘虏。

en.t: 1863 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1863 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 16th Wisconsin Legislature on January 22, 1863. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator James R. Doolittle was re-elected on the first ballot. At the start of the 1863 term, Republicans held majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, but their majorities were bolstered by three "pro-Union" fusion candidates, some of whom had previously been Democrats.

zh.t: 1863年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1863年1月22日，威斯康星州第十六届议会举行联邦参议员选举，共和党籍现任詹姆斯·R.杜利特尔首轮投票即获连任。当届议会开始时，共和党在两院均占多数，并得到三名“支持联邦”的联合候选人加强，其中一些人此前是民主党人。

en.t: 1873 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1873 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 26th Wisconsin Legislature on January 22, 1873. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Timothy O. Howe was re-elected on the first ballot, becoming the first three-term U.S. senator from Wisconsin. At the start of the 1873 term, Republicans held majorities in both chambers of the Wisconsin Legislature, and were easily able to re-elect their incumbent U.S. senator.

zh.t: 1873年美国威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1873年1月22日，威斯康星州第二十六届议会举行联邦参议员选举。共和党籍现任蒂莫西·O.豪在首轮投票获连任，成为该州首位获选三个任期的联邦参议员。当届议会开始时，共和党在两院都占多数，因此能够轻松选出现任者连任。

en.s: The Canadian federal election of 1874 was held on January 22, 1874, to elect members of the Canadian House of Commons of the 3rd Parliament of Canada. Sir John A. Macdonald, who had recently been forced out of office as prime minister, and his Conservatives were defeated by the Liberal Party under their new leader Prime Minister Alexander Mackenzie. Macdonald's government had been forced to resign on November 5, 1873 because of allegations of corruption relating to the construction of the Canadian Pacific Railway (see the Pacific Scandal). The Liberals under Mackenzie formed a government two days later with an election called for January.

zh.s: 1874年1月22日，加拿大举行联邦选举，选出第三届国会众议员。约翰·A.麦克唐纳爵士刚被迫辞去总理，其保守党又败给新领袖亚历山大·麦肯齐总理领导的自由党。麦克唐纳政府因涉及加拿大太平洋铁路建设的贪腐指控，即“太平洋丑闻”，于1873年11月5日辞职。两天后，麦肯齐的自由党组阁，并宣布于1月选举。

en.t: 1879 United States Senate election in Wisconsin
en.s: The 1879 United States Senate election in Wisconsin was held in the 32nd Wisconsin Legislature on January 22, 1879. Incumbent Republican U.S. senator Timothy O. Howe ran for a fourth six-year term, but was defeated for renomination. Former U.S. senator Matthew H. Carpenter—who had been ousted by a split in the party four years earlier—was elected United States senator on the 1st ballot.

en.s: The Battle of Isandlwana (alternative spelling: Isandhlwana) on 22 January 1879 was the second major encounter in the Anglo-Zulu War between the British Empire and the Zulu Kingdom – the Battle of Nyezane having been fought and won earlier on the same day by Colonel Pearson's Coastal Column.

en.s: The Battle of Rorke's Drift, also known as the Defence of Rorke's Drift, was an engagement in the Anglo-Zulu War. The successful British defence of the Swedish mission station and British supply depot at Rorke's Drift, it was carried out by a vastly outnumbered British force under the command of Lieutenants John Chard of the Royal Engineers and Gonville Bromhead of the 24th Regiment of Foot. It holds the record for the largest number of Victoria Crosses awarded for a single battle. After a large contingent of Zulu warriors broke off from the main force during the final hours of the British defeat at the day-long Battle of Isandlwana on 22 January 1879, they travelled ten kilometres (six miles) to attack Rorke's Drift later that day, with fighting continuing into the following day.

zh.s: 罗克渡口战役又称罗克渡口防御战，是祖鲁战争期间的一场战斗。英国军队以少胜多，在皇家工兵团约翰·查德中尉和第24步兵团冈维尔·布罗姆黑德中尉的指挥下，成功守住瑞典传教站和英国补给站。这场战斗创下一次战役中获得维多利亚十字勋章人数最多的纪录。1879年1月22日，伊散德尔瓦纳战役持续一整天，英军战败。最后几小时里，大批祖鲁战士脱离主力，行进约10公里，于当天晚些时候进攻罗克渡口；战斗持续到次日。

en.s: The first football match in mainland Portugal took place in Campo Pequeno, Lisbon on 22 January 1889. Three months earlier, in October 1888, a test match had already been held in Cascais contested between members of the Sporting Club of Cascais, one of the first clubs dedicated to football in Portugal.

zh.t: 葡萄牙本土首场足球比赛
zh.s: 1889年1月22日，葡萄牙本土首场足球比赛在里斯本小坎普举行。三个月前的1888年10月，卡斯凯什体育俱乐部成员已在卡斯凯什进行过一场试验性质的比赛；该俱乐部是葡萄牙最早开展足球运动的组织之一。

en.s: The Russian Revolution of 1905, also known as the First Russian Revolution, was a revolution in the Russian Empire which began on 22 January 1905 and led to the establishment of a constitutional monarchy under the Russian Constitution of 1906, the country's first formal constitution.

zh.s: 1905年俄国革命又称第一次俄国革命，于1905年1月22日在俄罗斯帝国爆发，最终促成俄罗斯帝国于1906年宪法下建立君主立宪制。这是该国第一部正式宪法。

en.s: The Russian Revolution of 1905 began on 22 January 1905, the date of Bloody Sunday in Saint Petersburg, Russia. Imperial troops fired on a workers’ procession seeking reforms, triggering wider unrest. The date was January 9 in the Julian calendar then used in Russia.

zh.s: 1905年1月22日，俄罗斯圣彼得堡发生“血腥星期日”事件，帝国军队向要求改革的工人游行队伍开枪，引发更大范围的动荡。这一天通常被视为1905年俄国革命的起点，对应当时俄国使用的儒略历1月9日。

en.s: The 1903 Sanitary Board Election was supposed to be held on 22 January 1906 for the 2 unofficial seats in the Sanitary Board of Hong Kong. Only ratepayers who were included in the Special and Common Jury Lists of the years or ratepayers who are exempted from serving on Juries on account of their professional avocations were entitled to vote at the election. There were only two candidates therefore there was no formal election was held. Henry Humphreys and Augustus Shelton Hooper were elected.

zh.s: 香港洁净局两个非官守议席原定于1906年1月22日选举。具资格者仅包括列入当年特别或普通陪审员名单的纳税人，以及因职业而豁免担任陪审员的纳税人。由于只有两名候选人，未举行正式投票，亨利·汉弗莱斯与奥古斯塔斯·谢尔顿·胡珀直接当选。原文正文开头将这一届标作1903年。

en.s: The Guadalajara train disaster occurred around January 22, 1915, in Mexico and killed over 600 people. The Mexican Revolution was in full swing by 1915. After the assassination of Francisco Madero two years earlier, the presidency of the country was assumed by Victoriano Huerta, but revolutionary forces led by Venustiano Carranza and Pancho Villa overthrew him and Carranza became president in 1914. Villa however wanted to continue the revolution and an armed struggle ensued. On January 18, 1915 Carranza's troops captured Guadalajara in southwestern Mexico. He immediately ordered that the families of his troops be transported by train from Colima on the Pacific coast to his newly captured stronghold.

zh.t: 墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉铁路惨案
zh.s: 约在1915年1月22日，墨西哥瓜达拉哈拉发生铁路灾难，造成600多人死亡。当时墨西哥革命正酣。弗朗西斯科·马德罗两年前遇刺后，维克托里亚诺·韦尔塔出任总统，随后被贝努斯蒂亚诺·卡兰萨与潘乔·比利亚领导的革命军推翻。卡兰萨于1914年成为总统，但比利亚希望继续革命，双方因而爆发武装斗争。1915年1月18日，卡兰萨部队夺取墨西哥西南的瓜达拉哈拉，他立即下令把部队家属从太平洋海岸的科利马，乘火车送往新占领的据点。

en.s: The Battle of Cârlibaba was a battle of the Eastern Front of the World War I, fought between 18 and 22 January 1915. It took place near the village of Cârlibaba, Romania near the Bistrița river. It was fought between the Russian Empire, and the Austria-Hungary. The battle ended with the victory of Austria-Hungarian forces.

zh.s: 卡尔利巴巴战役是第一次世界大战东线的一场战斗，于1915年1月18日至22日在罗马尼亚卡尔利巴巴村附近的比斯特里察河一带进行。交战双方是俄罗斯帝国与奥匈帝国，最终奥匈帝国军队获胜。

en.s: The 1916 Drummoyne state by-election was held on 22 January 1916 to elect the member for Drummoyne in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly, following the death of Liberal Reform MP George Richards. The by-election resulted in Liberal Reform candidate Alexander Graff finishing in first place with 47.32% of the vote, followed by National Progressive candidate Frederick Parish on 21.24%.

zh.s: 1916年1月22日，德拉姆莫因州议席举行补选，选出新南威尔士州立法会代表。此次补选由自由改革党议员乔治·理查兹去世引发。自由改革党候选人亚历山大·格拉夫以47.32%的得票率居首，国家进步党候选人弗雷德里克·帕里什以21.24%位列第二。

en.t: Ramsay MacDonald becomes Britain’s first Labour prime minister
en.s: On 22 January 1924, Ramsay MacDonald became the United Kingdom’s first Labour prime minister. He also served as foreign secretary, leading a minority government with tacit Liberal support.

en.s: The Czortków uprising (Polish: Powstanie Czortkowskie) was a failed attempt at resisting Soviet state repressions by the young anti-Soviet Poles most of whom were prewar students from the local high school. The uprising took place in the Soviet-occupied Polish town of Czortków (now Chortkiv, Ukraine) during World War II. The insurgents attempted to storm the local Red Army barracks and a prison in order to release Polish soldiers incarcerated there.

en.s: Convoy SC 20 was the 20th of the numbered series of World War II Slow Convoys of merchant ships from Sydney, Cape Breton Island to Liverpool. The trade convoy left Halifax on 22 January 1941 and was found by U-boats of the 2nd and 9th Flotillas, operating from Lorient and Brest, respectively. Five ships were sunk before the convoy reached Liverpool on 8 February.

zh.s: SC-20船队是第二次世界大战期间一系列编号慢速商船队中的第20支，航线从布雷顿角岛的悉尼港前往利物浦。船队于1941年1月22日离开哈利法克斯，途中被从洛里昂和布雷斯特出动的德国潜艇第2和第9舰队发现。船队抵达利物浦前有5艘船被击沉，最终于2月8日到港。

en.s: Operation Compass (also Italian: Battaglia della Marmarica) was the first large British military operation of the Western Desert Campaign (1940–1943) during the Second World War. British metropolitan, Imperial and Commonwealth forces attacked the Italian and Libyan forces of the 10th Army (Marshal Rodolfo Graziani) in western Egypt and Cyrenaica, the eastern province of Libya, from December 1940 to February 1941.
en.n: World War II: British and Commonwealth troops capture Tobruk from Italian forces during Operation Compass.

zh.s: 指南针行动又称马尔马里卡战役，是第二次世界大战期间西部沙漠战役（1940—1943年）中的首场大型英军行动。1940年12月至1941年2月，英国本土部队、帝国部队和英联邦部队在埃及西部和利比亚东部昔兰尼加进攻意大利和利比亚第10集团军，后者由鲁道夫·格拉齐亚尼元帅指挥。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：英军和英联邦部队在指南针行动中从意大利军队手中夺取托布鲁克。

en.s: The British capture of Tobruk was a battle fought between 21 and 22 January 1941, as part of Operation Compass, the first offensive of the Western Desert Force (WDF) in the Western Desert Campaign of the Second World War. After defeating the Italians in the Battle of Bardia (3–5 January 1941), the 6th Australian Division and the 7th Armoured Division pressed on and made contact with the Italian garrison in Tobruk on 6 January.

en.s: The Battle of Muar was the last major battle of the Malayan Campaign during the Second World War. It took place from 14–22 January 1942 around Gemensah Bridge and on the Muar River. After the British defeat at Slim River, General Archibald Wavell, commander of ABDA, decided that Lieutenant General Lewis Heath's III Indian Corps should withdraw 240 kilometres (150 mi) south into the State of Johore to rest and regroup, while the Australian 8th Division would attempt to stop the Japanese advance.

zh.s: 麻六甲战役是第二次世界大战期间马来亚战役的最后一场重大战斗，于1942年1月14日至22日在金马士桥和麻六甲河一带进行。英军在双溪立比战役中战败后，盟军司令阿奇博尔德·韦维尔将军决定让刘易斯·希思中将率领的英属印度第3军向南撤退240公里，到柔佛州休整并重整队伍；澳大利亚第8师则试图阻挡日军推进。

en.s: The battle of Buna–Gona was part of the New Guinea campaign in the Pacific theatre during World War II. It followed the conclusion of the Kokoda Track campaign and lasted from 16 November 1942 until 22 January 1943. The battle was fought by Australian and United States forces against the Japanese beachheads at Buna, Sanananda and Gona. From these, the Japanese had launched an overland attack on Port Moresby.
en.n: World War II: Australian and American forces defeat Japanese army and navy units in the bitterly fought Battle of Buna–Gona.

zh.s: 布纳—戈纳战役是第二次世界大战太平洋战场新几内亚战役的一部分，发生在科科达小径战役结束后。战斗从1942年11月16日持续到1943年1月22日。澳大利亚和美国军队进攻日军在布纳、萨南安达和戈纳的滩头阵地；日军此前从这些地点向莫尔兹比港发动陆路进攻。
zh.n: 第二次世界大战：澳大利亚和美国军队在苦战后击败日军陆海军部队。

en.s: The Battle of Anzio was a battle of the Italian Campaign of World War II that commenced 22 January 1944. The battle began with the Allied amphibious landing known as Operation Shingle, and ended on 4 June 1944, with the invasion of Rome. The operation was opposed by German and by Italian Repubblica Sociale Italiana (RSI) forces in the area of Anzio and Nettuno.

zh.s: 1944年1月22日，第二次世界大战意大利战役中的安齐奥战役开始。盟军以代号“鹅卵石”的两栖登陆揭开战幕，在安齐奥和内图诺地区，遭到德军及意大利社会共和国军队抵抗。战役于6月4日盟军进入罗马时结束。

en.s: The Battle of Rapido River was fought from 20 to 22 January 1944 during one of the Allies' many attempts to breach the Winter Line during the Italian Campaign of World War II. Despite its name, the battle occurred on the Gari River. Units of the US 36th Infantry Division, commanded by Major General Fred Walker crossed the Gari River in boats and seized the west bank of the river.

en.t: In Iran, Qazi Muhammad declares the independent people's Republic of Mahabad at Chahar Cheragh Square in the Kurdish city of Mahabad; he becomes the new president and Haji Baba Sheikh becomes the prime minister
en.s: The Republic of Mahabad, also referred to as the Republic of Kurdistan (Kurdish: کۆماری کوردستان, romanized: Komarî Kurdistan; Persian: جمهوری مهاباد, romanized: Jomhuriye Mahâbâd), was a short-lived Kurdish self-governing unrecognized state in present-day Iran, from 22 January to 15 December 1946. The Republic of Mahabad, sometimes described as a puppet state of the Soviet Union, arose in northwestern Iran alongside the Azerbaijan People's Government, a similarly short-lived and unrecognized Soviet puppet state.

zh.t: 卡齐·穆罕默德在马哈巴德宣布成立库尔德人民共和国
zh.s: 马哈巴德共和国又称库尔德斯坦共和国（库尔德语：کۆماری کوردستان；转写：Komarî Kurdistan；波斯语：جمهوری مهاباد；转写：Jomhuriye Mahâbâd），是一个短暂存在、未获承认的自治库尔德政权，位于今天的伊朗境内。它于1946年1月22日至12月15日存在，有时被描述为苏联的傀儡国家。该共和国在伊朗西北部成立，与同样短暂存在、未获承认的苏联傀儡政权阿塞拜疆人民政府并存。

en.s: The Battle of Agios Vasileios (Greek: Μάχη στον Άγιο Βασίλειο) took place on 22 January 1949. It was fought during the course of Operation Peristera as part of the Greek Civil War, pitting forces of the communist Democratic Army of Greece (DSE) led by Alekos Tsoukopoulos against the nationalist government army under Periklis Papathanasiou. In the early morning hours of 22 January, nationalist Mountain Raider squadrons launched an attack on the village of Agios Vasileios.

zh.t: 阿吉奥斯瓦西利奥斯战役
zh.s: 1949年1月22日，希腊内战中的阿吉奥斯瓦西利奥斯战役爆发，是“佩里斯特拉行动”的一部分。阿莱科斯·楚科普洛斯率领共产主义的希腊民主军，与佩里克利斯·帕帕萨纳西乌指挥的民族主义政府军交战。当天凌晨，政府军山地突击队向阿吉奥斯瓦西利奥斯村发动攻击。

en.s: The 1949 Prahran state by-election was held on 22 January 1949 to elect the member for Prahran in the Victorian Legislative Assembly, following the death of Labor Party MP Bill Quirk. zh.s: 普拉兰州议席于1949年1月22日举行补选，选出维多利亚州立法会代表。此次补选由工党议员比尔·奎克去世引发。弗兰克·克里恩为工党保住该席位；面对当时执政的自由党，工党的得票率提高了1个百分点。

en.s: STS-42 was a NASA Space Shuttle Discovery mission with the Spacelab module. Liftoff was originally scheduled for 8:45 EST (13:45 UTC) on January 22, 1992, but the launch was delayed due to weather constraints. en.s: On January 22, 2010, a second round of fighting began in Beledweyne, Somalia. Hizbul Islam defeated Ahlu Sunna Waljama’a and retook the town and surrounding region. This entry marks the renewed fighting, following clashes earlier that month.

zh.t: 伊斯兰党武装重新占领贝莱德文
zh.s: 2010年1月22日，索马里贝莱德文爆发第二轮战斗。伊斯兰党武装击败“逊尼派信众组织”，重新占领该城及周边地区。本条记录的是当月较早交战之后的新一轮战斗。

en.s: UFC: Fight for the Troops 2 (also known as UFC Fight Night 23) was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on January 22, 2011 at Fort Hood, near Killeen, Texas. The event was the third that the UFC has hosted in cooperation with a US military base, following UFC Fight Night 7 and UFC: Fight for the Troops.

zh.s: 2011年1月22日，终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）在美国得克萨斯州基林附近的胡德堡，举办综合格斗赛事“为军人而战2”，又称UFC格斗之夜23。这是继UFC格斗之夜7及首届“为军人而战”后，UFC第三次与美国军事基地合作举办赛事。

en.s: The presidential election was held in Finland in January and February. The first round took place on 22 January 2012 with advance voting on 11–17 January, and the second round occurred on 5 February with advance voting on 25–31 January. The elected candidate's term began on 1 March 2012 and will last until 2018. The incumbent Tarja Halonen was ineligible for re-election, having served the maximum two terms. All the eight political parties represented in the Parliament nominated a candidate during the latter half of 2011.

zh.s: 2012年1月至2月，芬兰举行总统选举。首轮于1月22日进行，提前投票期为1月11日至17日；第二轮于2月5日进行，提前投票期为1月25日至31日。当选者任期从2012年3月1日至2018年。现任总统塔里娅·哈洛宁已任满最多两届，不能再参选。议会中八个政党均在2011年下半年提名候选人。

en.s: The 2013 Democratic National Committee chairmanship election was held at the Omni Shoreham Hotel in Washington, D.C. on January 22, 2013, at the party's winter meeting to determine the next chairperson of the Democratic National Committee (DNC). The chair election was uncontested, and Debbie Wasserman Schultz was reelected chairperson through a unanimous consent vote.

zh.t: 2013年美国民主党全国委员会主席选举
zh.s: 2013年1月22日，民主党在华盛顿特区奥姆尼肖勒姆酒店举行冬季会议，选举下一任全国委员会主席。选举没有竞争，黛比·沃瑟曼·舒尔茨经一致同意获选连任。

en.s: An election was held on 22 January 2013 for the post of Governor of the Indonesian province of South Sulawesi. The incumbent governor Syahrul Yasin Limpo of the Golkar party was re-elected with 52% of the vote. The principal opponent was Ilham Arief Sirajuddin of the Democratic Party, who obtained 42% of the vote.

zh.s: 印度尼西亚南苏拉威西省于2013年1月22日举行省长选举。时任省长、戈尔卡尔党成员沙鲁尔·亚辛·林波以52%的得票率连任。主要对手、民主党候选人伊尔哈姆·阿里夫·西拉朱丁获得42%的选票。

en.s: Island Assembly elections were held in Nevis on 22 January 2013 to elect five members of the Nevis Island Assembly. The result was a win for the Concerned Citizens' Movement (CCM), led by Vance Amory, which won three of the five seats. The opposition Nevis Reformation Party (NRP) won two seats.

zh.s: 尼维斯于2013年1月22日举行岛议会选举，选出5名议员。万斯·阿莫里领导的关注公民运动赢得3席，成为胜方；反对党尼维斯改革党获得2席。

en.s: Guerra de Titanes (Spanish for "War of the Titans") is a major professional wrestling event produced by Lucha Libre AAA World Wide (AAA), a Mexican promotion. The event was originally announced for December 5, 2015, but was postponed to January 22, 2016, with no official explanation for the delay. The event is the nineteenth Guerra de Titanes show, traditionally AAA's "end of the year" that started in 1997, breaking with tradition in 2016.

zh.s: 《泰坦之战》是墨西哥职业摔角联盟AAA制作的大型职业摔角赛事。赛事原定于2015年12月5日举行，后改期至2016年1月22日，主办方没有说明原因。这是该系列第19届，系列赛事自1997年起通常在年底举行；2016年改期打破了这一惯例。

en.t: January 2017 Party of Free Citizens leadership election
en.s: The Party of Free Citizens leadership election of 2017 was held on 22 January 2017. It was held after the incumbent leader Petr Mach resigned in December 2016. Mach was reelected when he received more than 60% of votes. Voter turnout was about 50%.

zh.t: 2017年1月捷克自由公民党党首选举
zh.s: 2017年1月22日，捷克自由公民党举行党首选举。彼得·马赫此前于2016年12月辞去党首职务，这次以超过60%的得票率重新当选。投票率约为50%。

en.s: The 2017 Yamagata Gubernatorial Election was a gubernatorial election that was called in Yamagata Prefecture for 22 January 2017. Mieko Yoshimura, governor since 2009, ran for a third term. Her Prefectural Citizen's Party alliance was supported by the Democratic Party, the Social Democratic Party, and the Communist Party. Because no other candidates entered the race, Yoshimura was declared the winner without a vote.

zh.s: 山形县于2017年1月22日举行知事选举。自2009年起担任知事的吉村美荣子竞选第三个任期。她领导的县民党联盟得到民主党、社会民主党和共产党支持。由于没有其他候选人参选，吉村未经投票即被宣布当选。

en.s: The 2017 Thailand Champions Cup was the first Thailand Champions Cup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Thai League 1 and Thai FA Cup competitions. The match was played at Supachalasai Stadium, Bangkok and contested by 2016 Thai League T1 champions SCG Muangthong United, and Sukhothai as the champions of the 2016 Thai FA Cup.

zh.s: 2017年泰国冠军杯是首届赛事。这项年度足球比赛由上赛季泰国足球甲级联赛和泰国足总杯冠军对阵。本届比赛在曼谷苏帕查拉赛体育场举行，参赛队伍是2016赛季泰国甲级联赛冠军蒙通联队，以及泰国足总杯冠军素可泰队。

en.s: Raw 25 Years was a special episode of WWE's weekly television series Raw, broadcast on the USA Network on January 22, 2018. The episode was a commemoration of the 25th anniversary of the program's debut in January 1993. The event was held in two separate venues in New York City – the Barclays Center in Brooklyn and the Manhattan Center Grand Ballroom in Manhattan, the latter of which hosted the first episode of Raw.The event also featured various appearances from WWE Hall of Famers and legends.

zh.s: 《Raw 25 Years》是WWE周播节目《Raw》的一期特别节目，于2018年1月22日在USA电视网播出，纪念该节目于1993年1月首播25周年。活动在纽约市两个场馆举行：布鲁克林的巴克莱中心和曼哈顿中心大宴会厅，后者曾举办《Raw》首期节目。多位WWE名人堂成员和传奇选手也到场亮相。

en.s: An indirect presidential election were held in Greece on Wednesday 22 January 2020 for the President of the Hellenic Republic. Incumbent President Prokopis Pavlopoulos, who was elected by the Hellenic Parliament on 18 February 2015, was eligible for re-election but did not seek re-election. Katerina Sakellaropoulou won the election with 261 votes. She was elected as the 13th and first female President of Greece.

zh.s: 2020年1月22日星期三，希腊举行间接总统选举。现任总统普罗科皮斯·帕夫洛普洛斯于2015年2月18日获议会选出，虽有资格连任，却没有再参选。卡特里娜·萨克拉罗普卢以261票获胜，成为希腊第13任总统，也是首位女总统。

en.s: On January 22, 2021, ONE Championship held Unbreakable, also known as ONE Championship 126, at the Singapore Indoor Stadium in Singapore.

zh.s: 2021年1月22日，ONE冠军赛在新加坡室内体育馆举办“坚不可摧”（Unbreakable）赛事，也称ONE冠军赛第126期。

en.t: AMC Fight Nights: Steel Heart XI
en.s: On January 22, 2021, AMC Fight Nights held Steel Heart XI, a mixed martial arts event, at Arena Metallurg in Magnitogorsk, Russia.

zh.s: 2021年1月22日，AMC Fight Nights在俄罗斯马格尼托哥尔斯克的冶金体育馆举办“钢铁之心XI”综合格斗赛。

en.s: The 2020 UAE Super Cup was the 13th professional and 20th overall UAE Super Cup, an annual football match played between the winners of the previous season's Pro-League and President's Cup. Due to the cancellation of last year's tournament as a result of the COVID-19 pandemic, the super cup was contested as a repeat between the participants of last season's league and cup winners, Sharjah and Shabab Al Ahli.

zh.s: 2020年阿联酋超级杯是职业联赛时代的第13届、总计第20届赛事。这项年度足球比赛由上赛季阿联酋职业联赛和总统杯冠军对阵。由于新冠疫情导致上一年度赛事取消，本届比赛由上赛季联赛和杯赛冠军重赛，参赛队伍是沙迦队和沙巴布阿赫利队。

en.s: The 16th Congress of the Popular Front for the Liberation of Saguia El Hamra and Río de Oro (Arabic: المؤتمر السادس عشر للجبهة الشعبية لتحرير الساقية الحمراء ووادي الذهب, Spanish: XVI Congreso del Frente Popular para la Liberación de Saguia El Hamra y Río de Oro) was held in the Dajla refugee camp in Tindouf, Algeria between 13 and 22 January 2023 to renovate the governing bodies of the Polisario Front and establish the movement's main lines of action and strategy for the next leadership term.

zh.t: 波利萨里奥阵线第16次代表大会
zh.s: 2023年1月13日至22日，萨基亚阿姆拉和里奥德奥罗人民解放阵线，通常称波利萨里奥阵线，在阿尔及利亚廷杜夫的达赫拉难民营举行第16次代表大会。大会更新领导机构，并确定下届领导任期内的主要行动方针及战略。

en.t: 2023 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final
en.s: The 2023 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship final was a hurling match that was played at Croke Park on 22 January 2023 to determine the winners of the 2022-23 All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, the 52nd season of the All-Ireland Senior Club Hurling Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champion clubs of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 2023年全爱尔兰俱乐部高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2023年全爱尔兰俱乐部高级曲棍球锦标赛决赛于2023年1月22日在克罗克公园举行，决出2022—23赛季冠军。这是该赛事第52届，由盖尔体育协会主办，参赛的是爱尔兰四个省的冠军俱乐部。

en.t: 2023 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election
en.s: The 2023 New Zealand Labour Party leadership election was held on 22 January 2023 to choose the next leader of the New Zealand Labour Party. The election was triggered by the resignation of Prime Minister and Labour Party Leader Jacinda Ardern, which was announced on 19 January 2023. With Chris Hipkins as the only candidate, he won the election by default.

zh.s: 新西兰工党于2023年1月22日举行党魁选举，选出下一任党魁。此次选举由总理兼党魁杰辛达·阿德恩于1月19日宣布辞职引发。克里斯·希普金斯是唯一候选人，因此自动当选。

en.s: The siege of Babanusa was a siege of the Sudanese civil war. The siege started when fighting erupted between the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) and the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) on 22 January 2024 near Babanusa. On 1 December 2025, RSF took control of the city after a prolonged siege.

zh.s: 2024年1月22日，苏丹快速支援部队与苏丹武装部队在巴巴努萨附近开战，围城战由此开始，是苏丹内战的一部分。长期围困后，快速支援部队于2025年12月1日控制该城。

en.s: The 2023 Supercoppa Italiana final was a football match to decide the winners of the 2023 Supercoppa Italiana, the Italian football super cup. It was the 36th edition of the annual tournament, which was also the first edition to feature a final match in the new four-team format. The match was played on 22 January 2024 at the King Saud University Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

zh.s: 2024年1月22日，第36届意大利超级杯决赛，在沙特阿拉伯利雅得的沙特国王大学体育场举行，决出2023年度冠军。这是年度赛事首次采用四队参赛的新赛制，并单独设置决赛。

en.s: On January 22, 2025 the Philippine Army looking to escort a United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) team was attacked by "lawless elements" backed by some gunmen from the Moro Islamic Liberation Front (MILF). The encounter occurred at Sumisip, Basilan, Philippines.

zh.s: 2025年1月22日，菲律宾陆军准备护送一支联合国开发计划署团队时，在巴西兰省苏米西普遭到“不法分子”袭击，对方得到摩洛伊斯兰解放阵线部分枪手支持。

en.s: The 2024 Supercopa Paraguay was the fourth edition of the Supercopa Paraguay, Paraguay's football super cup. It was held on 22 January 2025 at Estadio Defensores del Chaco in Asunción between the 2024 Primera División best-ranked champions in the aggregate table Olimpia and the 2024 Copa Paraguay champions Libertad. This match, which was originally scheduled to be played on 23 January, was the opening event of the 2025 season of Paraguayan football.

zh.s: 2024年巴拉圭超级杯是巴拉圭足球超级杯的第4届赛事。比赛于2025年1月22日在亚松森的查科捍卫者体育场举行，由2024年巴拉圭甲级联赛积分榜排名最高的冠军奥林匹亚队对阵2024年巴拉圭杯冠军自由队。比赛原定于1月23日举行，并作为2025赛季巴拉圭足球的揭幕战。
